reward_note: Beating 奇格萨 gave its first stage 萨格 (4399: 击败后获得新精灵萨格); encoded as 奇格萨 精元 hatching 萨格.

capture.zh: 在英佩恩堡垒二层与奇格萨进行普通精灵挑战，胜利后获得萨格精元；无需其他玩家或组队入口。

strategy_notes.zh: 攻略作者只放了一个千烈就打倒了它——实力不强，难点在于遇到它。

engine_notes: Current single-player adaptation: a direct ordinary challenge against one Qigesa. No cooperative lobby, other-player requirement, random-floor ladder, or multiplayer formation is implemented. The original 2010 source required a team and placed Qigesa on a random floor; that is historical context only.
Level/HP not published; the boss went down to one big hit, so Lv60 / 1000 HP are low-confidence estimates.
Historical source quotation: "挑战必须由组队进行". This describes the original multiplayer mode and is not an entry rule in the remake.
source_note: 4399 赛尔号勇士试炼 (2010-11-12): location, co-op rule, random floor, 萨格 reward.
